title: In repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts, pass the trace metadata through to applyOutcomeToPosteriors so an
description:
In repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts, pass the trace metadata through to applyOutcomeToPosteriors so an already-landed consumer check can fire.

ANCHOR: the exact line `          failure_mode: (body.failure_mode ?? null) as any,` occurs exactly once in the file (verified with rg -F -c: 1 match). Insert a new property immediately AFTER that line, inside the same object literal. Do not modify that anchor line itself and do not reflow any surrounding line.

INSERT exactly this, at the same indentation as the anchor line:
          ...(typeof (body.metadata as { information_yield?: unknown } | undefined)?.information_yield === 'string'
            ? { metadata: { information_yield: (body.metadata as { information_yield: string }).information_yield } }
            : {}),

This deliberately mirrors the sibling_group_size spread that already exists a few lines below in the same object literal, which reads `...(typeof (body.metadata as { siblingGroupSize?: unknown } | undefined)?.siblingGroupSize === 'number' ? { sibling_group_size: ... } : {})`. Follow that idiom exactly; it is the in-file precedent for conditionally forwarding a field off body.metadata.

WHY: commit 0772deb already landed the consumer half in repos/activity-api/src/lib/posterior-update.ts — TraceForPosterior declares `metadata?: { information_yield?: string }` and line 1073 reads `const skipVariantUpdate = tierClass === 'all_deterministic' || trace.metadata?.information_yield === 'idle';`, which gates the alpha/beta increment. That check is currently DEAD because applyOutcomeToPosteriors has exactly three call sites and none passes metadata. This call site (the main ingest path) is the important one: it builds an explicit object literal and already reaches INTO body.metadata for siblingGroupSize, then projects the rest away, so trace.metadata is permanently undefined and the landed condition can never evaluate true. The producer is fine — light-dispatch-vessel/src/index.ts:971-982 posts metadata:{ information_yield }.

Do NOT add or modify any interface. TraceForPosterior already declares the metadata field; adding another declaration would create a duplicate (that already happened once in this codebase and had to be cleaned up). Do NOT touch the two other call sites in routes/activities.ts or routes/goal-paths.ts in this change. Do NOT touch the projection or limit logic earlier in this file.

CONSEQUENCE THIS ENABLES: activities whose traces record information_yield "idle" will stop accruing positive Thompson alpha. Measured example of the defect: docs-mgmt:docs-decision-deliver has total_executions 1495 and thompson_alpha 728.887 while every one of its traces carries impulses_created [] and metadata.information_yield "idle".
